top_signals.title: Japan to apply reconstruction aid law to all of Kumamoto Prefecture
top_signals.summary: Under the law, families whose homes were destroyed or partially damaged will be eligible for up to ¥3 million in aid to cover costs for housing construction, repair and rent.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
